summary: Iteration 5: verified per-element ANIMATION presets and scene BACKGROUND fit + dim-overlay end-to-end. Backend (new /app/backend/tests/test_anim_bg.py, 5/5 pass): (1) POST /api/scenes persists background={color,type:'image',src,fit:'repeat',overlayColor:'#123456',overlayOpacity:0.42} and elements[].props.animation='pulse' + animationDuration=1.5; GET /api/scenes/{id} returns them intact. (2) PUT /api/scenes/{id} round-trips fit through cover/contain/repeat and overlayOpacity through 0.7 (note: PUT requires full SceneInput body, not a patch). (3) GET /api/public/scene/{token}/overlay HTML contains @keyframes clara-pulse/fade/spin/bounce/float/blink/slide, applyAnim helper, backgroundRepeat branch, and the exact overlayColor value #123456. (4) Regression: GET /api/public/scene/{token}/element/{id}.txt returns the element value. Frontend (Playwright, all assertions pass): MFA login OK; created TEST_FE_Anim scene; added all 5 element types (add-text/add-clock/add-image/add-timed_text/add-api_field) — each keeps properties-panel open on selection; prop-animation Select renders with options none/pulse/fade/spin/bounce/float/blink/slide; selecting 'pulse' reveals prop-anim-speed slider AND applies inline style containing 'clara-pulse' to the inner wrapper on the canvas; setting bg-media to https://example.com/tile.png reveals bg-fit + bg-overlay-color + bg-overlay-opacity; setting fit=Repeat(tile) and opacity=0.55 then save-scene-btn persists — after page reload the bg-fit shows 'Repeat (tile)', overlay-opacity input value = 0.55, and clara-pulse animation is still applied.
critical_code_review_comments: PUT /api/scenes/{id} requires the FULL SceneInput (name, workspace_id, elements, background). A partial-update PATCH endpoint would reduce client-side race conditions and payload size; not blocking but worth considering.

SceneEditor onChange still infers background.type from URL extension (/\.(mp4|webm|mov|ogg)$/i) — a video/tile served without a known extension (CDN/presigned) is misclassified as type:'image'. Carried over from iter 4.
Overlay HTML uses inline style.animation via applyAnim on the inner wrapper — same shape as SceneCanvas, good parity. No handling for reduced-motion (prefers-reduced-motion) — cosmetic.
No validation on background.overlayOpacity range in Pydantic (client can send 5.0 or -1). Consider clamping 0..1 server-side.
No enum validation on background.fit or props.animation server-side; unknown values are stored as-is (frontend defaults to 'cover' / no-op if unknown, so not a break).
Carried over: server.py upload_file still buffers full file in memory before size check; content-type trusted from client; no DELETE for uploads (orphan cleanup); /auth/2fa/reset without re-auth.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on the two new features + regression on element add + property-panel selection

seed_data_creation: Test scenes were created and cleaned up (TEST_AnimBG_Scene, TEST_AnimBG_Regress, TEST_FE_Anim all deleted). No S3 uploads this iteration.
